dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.
Rules, gates, evidence checks, and validation criteria.
Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.
Known limitations, failure modes, and unsupported assumptions.

fusion_rules.rule: Monitor competitors and platform shifts, analyze response options, and keep competitive claims tied to verifiable observations.
Accept only: Competitor releases, market signals, comparable products, and monitoring evidence.
Produce only: A verified competitive intelligence brief, response choice, and follow-up observation plan.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: Competitor releases, market signals, comparable products, and monitoring evidence.
output_boundary: A verified competitive intelligence brief, response choice, and follow-up observation plan.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 先证明某格式已成为用户期待的 industry primitive，再按本产品情境采用，而不是照抄竞争 feature。; 提供 competitor iceberg 模型入口，提醒已发布 feature 只是研究与战略的表层结果。; 标记脱离客户、规则和数据模型而复制 competitor UI/feature 的反应式 anti-pattern。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 只有用户证据表明期待该格式时才是 primitive；流行 feature 不满足。; 这是 anti-copying 指针；不禁止采用用户期待的 primitive。; 只识别 anti-pattern；发现复制不证明 rules/data 一定构成 moat。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 12 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (exception=1, method=2, rule=4, template=3, tool-action=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 提供 competitor iceberg 模型入口，提醒已发布 feature 只是研究与战略的表层结果。; 把 release 记录为 chess move，说明所建内容、相对影响、得失，并从 solution、distribution、pricing/packaging 三维评分。; 把 competitor shipment 与背后的研究、客户理解和战略分层；限制检查频率并将创意决策锚定用户访谈。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 这是 anti-copying 指针；不禁止采用用户期待的 primitive。; 必须覆盖 built、relative effect、gain/loss 及 solution/distribution/pricing；缺项不完整。; 适用于因竞品发布而拟复制 feature 的决策；需本方 user interviews，三个月是摘录上限而非普遍最佳值，水下研究与战略不得臆测。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 7 source-grounded atom(s) for method (method=2, template=3, tool-action=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 提供 competitor iceberg 模型入口，提醒已发布 feature 只是研究与战略的表层结果。; 生成三部分 competitive/comparables analysis：1) 各 player 的 head-to-head features/strengths summary，并以 color coding OR heat map 呈现强弱；2) 各 player 的 focus/investment themes commentary；3) key feature deconstructs AND screenshots。; 同时纳入 direct competitors 与异市场 comparables，输出 heat map、投资主题和 feature deconstructs。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 这是 anti-copying 指针；不禁止采用用户期待的 primitive。; 三个组件全部必需；第一组件可在 color coding OR heat map 两种呈现中任选其一，第三组件的 key feature deconstructs AND screenshots 两项都必须提供。若因授权或环境限制无法生成 screenshots，正式 competitive/comparables analysis 必须标记 incomplete/defer，不得视为三组件通过；该权限处理是 curated safeguard，不是来源原文。; 紧邻 block quote 是本地 quote-backed evidence；title/URL/timestamp 未外部核验。comparables 不能替代 direct competitors；heat map、investment themes 与 feature deconstructs 是该 guest Tactical advice 的建议性、部分重叠支持，不单独构成完整三组件 Gate。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 3 source-grounded atom(s) for inputs-and-outputs (template=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 记录 candidate format、user-expectation evidence、primitive verdict、context adaptation 与 rejected copy elements；仅因流行而采用则失败。; 检查 user expectation evidence、primitive decision、context adaptation、non-copy rationale；无期待证据则 defer。; 检查输出逐项记录 roadmap item、direct-interview evidence、niche problem、competitor-trigger flag、proceed/defer decision；缺少决定性前提时标 unknown/defer，不得越权下结论。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 只有用户证据表明期待该格式时才是 primitive；流行 feature 不满足。; 紧邻 block quote 是本地 quote-backed evidence；title/URL/timestamp 未外部核验。必须证明 users expect format；primitive adoption 不等同 feature copying。; Insight/Tactical advice 仅为本地 curated summary、不是逐字引语；title/URL/timestamp 未外部核验。必须有 direct customer research；不足时 roadmap defer。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 4 source-grounded atom(s) for gates-and-validation (rule=4); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 用 AI 查询并综合 specific competitor GTM、market usage patterns 与 upsell mechanics，产出待核验的 competitive-intelligence hypotheses。; 用 AI 聚合新领域的 market context/competitive intelligence、specific competitor value propositions、industry trends 与 potential disruptions，形成待核验研究摘要。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: Insight/Tactical advice 是本地 curated summary、不是逐字引语；title/URL/timestamp 未外部核验。authorized data/tool access 与 citation verification 是策展 safeguards、非来源原文；AI 输出在核验前不得当作事实。; Insight/Tactical advice 是本地 curated summary、不是逐字引语；title/URL/timestamp 未外部核验。authorization 与 item-level source verification 是策展 safeguards、非来源原文；速度不等于准确，核验前只能标 hypothesis。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 2 source-grounded atom(s) for permissions-and-side-effects (tool-action=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.
